newsitem.title: GREECE: Athens bourse clears Katselis rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Athens bourse clears Katselis rights issue.

text.p: The Athens stock exchange cleared the 513 million drachma rights issue of Katselis SA, it said in a statement.
Katselis, an industrial bakery, will issue 371,910 new common bearer shares with a par value of 100 drachmas.
The terms are 98 new common bearer shares per 1,000 outstanding, either common or preferred, at 1,380 drachmas each.

Katselis will use proceeds for working capital purposes and to complete its 1.02 billion drachma investment programme for 1995-97 which is subsidised at 35 percent by the Greek ministry of development. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
